question: Where will GPT-6 Astra rank on the LMArena Text Arena leaderboard on September 18, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Two questions stacked: does gpt-6-astra get published on Text Arena in time, and where does it land. Timing dominates. Changelog listing lags from public release: claude-fable-5.1 1 day, gemini-3.8-flash 0 days, gpt-5.5-high 4 days -- but gpt-5.6 (Jul 9 release) took until Jul 31, 22 days. Astra launched Sep 3/4 and is already in the Arena; it was added to Code Arena: WebDev on Sep 5 (and took #1 there at 1797) but the Sep 5 changelog explicitly did NOT add it to Text. The displayed Text snapshot is still Sep 2 as of Now (Sep 7), and 2026 Text-addition dates show gaps up to 13 days, so the Sep 18 page may show a ~Sep 9-16 snapshot. I put listing-in-time at ~62%. Conditional on listing, I anchor the score distribution on the actively-traded Polymarket debut-score ladder, mapping scores to ranks off the Sep 2 table (Rank1-3 needs >=1504, 4-6 needs 1498-1503, 7-10 needs 1492-1497, 11-20 needs 1482-1491). I shade the top bucket down and the sub-1480 bucket down relative to the market: OpenAI's ceiling on this leaderboard has been flat at ~1483 for two generations (gpt-5.5-high 1482, gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh 1483, best OpenAI rank 17) while Anthropic climbed to 1507, so #1 requires breaking a persistent style-preference pattern -- but a GPT-6-class flagship falling below a two-generation-old model is also unlikely, and the criteria take the best of any gpt-6-astra* variant. Evidence is genuinely thin on the timing side: no source states whether Astra is currently accumulating Text Arena battles.

calls.reasoning: Two-stage: P(listed by Sep 18) x P(rank bucket | listed). Listing dominates. Arena publishes a Text score the same day it adds a model (gemini-3.8-flash-high, claude-fable-5.1-max both added and ranked Sep 2), so the pre-tested day-one path has already been missed for Astra: 4 days post-release it is in Agent and Code:WebDev but absent from the Text changelog and from the live Sep 2 board. Fresh text votes must now accumulate, and the published snapshot itself lags ~5 days (likely Wednesday cadence, giving Sep 9 and Sep 16 as the only two chances). I put listing at ~58%, below the reference class's ~70% because the fastest route visibly failed. Conditional on listing, I center the debut near 1497 on the style-control board (gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh sits at 1483; a full generation bump is +10 to +30) with SD ~14, adjusted up for style control favoring OpenAI ~5 ranks and for best-of-multiple-variants, adjusted down for board drift. The board is brutally compressed - rank 1 to 25 is 30 Elo - so Rank 4-6 spans only 6 points and gets less mass than three slots suggest, while Rank 21+ is unbounded below. Evidence cuts both ways: Astra is #1 on Code Arena WebDev by 35 points (a human-preference arena), but trails Claude Fable 5.1 on intelligence indices (54.7 vs 56.8) and OpenAI's best current Text entry is only #17.

calls.reasoning: Two stacked uncertainties. (1) Listing: Astra released Sep 3/4 and as of Sep 7 appears in exactly ONE arena (Code WebDev, added Sep 5); Text Arena's newest snapshot is still Sep 2. The closest precedent is near-identical: GPT-5.6 hit Code Arena day+1, Agent day+4, but Text Arena only day+18 to +22. GPT-5.2-chat took ~23 days from Vision to Text. Against that, GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.5 reached Text at day 0 and day 4, Anthropic/Google models land day 0-1, the changelog shows Text Arena updates every 1-8 days, and arena demonstrably already has serving access. Surviving 4 days unlisted kills the day-0/day-1 mass, so I put listing-by-Sep-18 near a coin flip, slightly favorable. (2) Rank given listed: OpenAI's ceiling on this board has been rank 17-19 (gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh 1483, gpt-5.5-high 1482) while Anthropic holds 1502-1507; a generational jump plus a dominant WebDev human-preference result argues for a real gain, but Artificial Analysis (Fable 5.1 56.8 vs Astra 54.7) and press reporting say Astra trails Anthropic on general text. The $253k Polymarket debut-score book implies roughly a 1490-ish median, which maps to rank ~11-12, with fat tails both ways. I spread the conditional mass accordingly, mildly downweighting the very top.

calls.reference_class: Frontier LLM releases tracked in the Arena (LMArena) leaderboard changelog, Jul-Sep 2026: elapsed days from public release / Code Arena listing to appearance on the Text Arena Overall leaderboard, plus the debut rank of OpenAI flagships on that board

calls.reasoning: Two stacked uncertainties, and timing dominates. Verified directly today: the Text Arena page still shows the Sep 2 snapshot with no gpt-6-astra row, and the changelog's latest entry (Sep 5) adds gpt-6-astra-max to Code Arena: WebDev only. The modal path for 2026 flagships -- pre-tested anonymously, listed on Text day 0-1 -- is therefore already falsified for Astra, which kills most of the unconditional ~70% listing rate Runs 1-3 anchor on. What remains is the OpenAI-flagship pattern, and Astra's arena sequence (Agent ~day 0, Code day 2, Text absent day 4) matches GPT-5.6's exactly; GPT-5.6 reached Text at day 18-22, which maps to ~Sep 22-26, past the deadline. Against that: Arena has serving access, said 'scores coming soon', Text additions run every 1-8 days, and non-OpenAI Code-to-Text gaps of +1 and +5 days would still land in time. I put P(listed and displayed by Sep 18) at ~0.43. Conditional on listing, OpenAI's two-generation ceiling of 1482-1483 (ranks 17-19) versus Anthropic's 1502-1507 argues for mid-table, while a +35-point Code Arena WebDev #1 and a genuine generational jump argue higher; the board is compressed enough (30 Elo from rank 1 to 25) that the conditional mass spreads broadly across ranks 4-20.
calls.reconciliation: Disputed premises checked this run, with outcomes. (1) Astra on Text Arena now: fetched arena.ai/leaderboard/text -- snapshot label 'Sep 2, 2026', 7,999,020 votes / 400 models, no gpt-6-astra row; top rows unchanged from the dossiers (1 claude-fable-5 1507, 2 claude-opus-4-6-high 1505, 3 claude-fable-5.1-max 1504). Confirms all four runs. (2) Changelog past Sep 5: fetched arena.ai/blog/leaderboard-changelog -- latest entry is Sep 5 (gpt-6-astra-max to Code Arena: WebDev; Claude Fable 5.1 Max to Agent; grok-imagine-video-1.5-agent to Text-to-Video). Sep 4 = wan3.0 to Text-to-Video. No Text Arena entry for any astra variant on any date. Confirms Run 4's sequencing and refutes any reading that a Text listing has quietly happened. (3) Snapshot cadence (Run 2/4 'weekly Wednesday' vs Run 1/3 'addition-driven'): CAME BACK EMPTY -- no documented schedule exists on the site. Both readings converge operationally, since the Sep 1 and Sep 2 Text additions each showed same-day, so a listing by ~Sep 16 would display on Sep 18 and Sep 17 is marginal; I apply a small haircut for that. (4) Market: I pulled the Polymarket book myself rather than trusting the dossiers' characterisation. It is 'Debut at score >=1480/1490/1500/1510/1520', resolving off the NO-STYLE-CONTROL Overall view at 12:00 PM ET the day after first appearance, AutoEval excluded, deadline Dec 31 2026. Three clauses differ from this question: deadline (Dec 31 vs Sep 18), metric (score vs ordinal rank), and view (no-style-control vs the page default, which orders OpenAI models ~5 ranks better). So it is a near-miss contract: evidence on the conditional shape, and no evidence at all on the timing question that dominates here. Its ladder implies a median debut in the high-1490s on the no-SC scale; the SC translation is too noisy to import as a level (observed SC-minus-noSC deltas across models range -12 to +13, with OpenAI's single observation at +11), so I widened rather than shifted. (5) Searched for any published Astra Text Arena score or any Kalshi/Manifold/bookmaker contract on Astra's Text RANK: CAME BACK EMPTY -- results returned only the Code Arena WebDev #1 story (1797 pts, +35 over claude-fable-5.1-max) and the same Polymarket event. The remaining dispute, P(listed by Sep 18), is JUDGMENT, and no evidence breaks it cleanly. I side substantially with Run 4 rather than the 3-run majority, because the majority's ~0.6 rests on the unconditional Arena cadence while the conditioning event -- OpenAI flagship, Code Arena entry already published, Text still absent at day 4 -- has exactly two precedents (GPT-5.6, gpt-5.2-chat) and both took 18-23 days. I stop short of Run 4's 0.30 because n=2 is thin, the pipeline is demonstrably active, and non-OpenAI +1/+5-day Code-to-Text gaps would still fit the window. That puts me at P(listed) ~0.43, outside all four runs on the low side of three and the high side of one, and I carry Run 2/3's conditional rank shape forward with slightly more mass at ranks 7-20 than at the very top, since OpenAI has never placed above #17 on this specific board.
